description: This Java class defines a Freemarker template transform for formatting numbers within the OFBiz framework, including methods for extracting arguments and formatting numbers based on locale and format parameters.

classes.name: OfbizNumberTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation for formatting numbers with locale and format options.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map, handling TemplateScalarModel types.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Extracts a numeric value from the arguments map, converting various object types to Double.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that formats a number according to specified locale and format when closed.
